data.long_meaning: The name Shinu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shyam', which means 'dark' or 'black'. In Hindu mythology, Shinu is considered to be the goddess of love and beauty, often depicted as having dark complexion. She is believed to bring joy, happiness and calmness to her devotees. The name Shinu carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Beauty” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Malayalam. Parents who choose Shinu usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
